# PillChain

Event info as a chain of pills, from the festival-poster reference: name, date, arrow, time and venue, with an "echo" of fading circles.

`Gathr.PillChain` · Expression

## Use

```jsx
<Gathr.PillChain rows={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gathr.PillChain" rows="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
